Crossvault Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Microsoft Corporation (MSFT) by 6.61% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Crossvault Capital Management Llc sold 5,454 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.64% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,048 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $8.81 million, down from 82,502 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Crossvault Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $784.95 billion market cap company.
